title: Pair branch-first adoption with output-only publication
summary: Explore an opt-in workflow that keeps editable records in the adopter's catalog branch and publishes derived artifacts with an exact-source receipt. Apply it to Provenistem output and evaluate portability separately.

origin.source: Provenistem standalone planning and repository audit, 2026-11-20.

benefits: Keeps the browser view reproducible and the records authoritative.
risks: Publishing from private inputs can expose project data.
An artifact can expire before its review is complete.

evidence.claim: Veraphify generates and retains derived artifacts in its adopter-owned workflow.
